text: JPMorgan Chase established two co-president positions and appointed Doug Petno and Troy Rohrbaugh to the roles. Leadership responsibilities for the firm's principal operating divisions were reassigned, while Marianne Lake announced her retirement. The governance changes include succession-focused retention awards tied to future performance and continued employment.

meta.note: Leadership responsibilities are redistributed while overall executive governance remains operational.

text: The core personal consumption expenditures price index registered a 3.4% annual increase, while headline PCE reached 4.1% annually. Personal consumption expenditures and personal income each increased 0.7% for the month. First-quarter GDP was revised upward to a 2.1% annualized rate, and initial jobless claims declined. Market expectations continued to include the possibility of a future policy rate increase.

meta.note: Inflation and real activity measures move concurrently without converging to a single macroeconomic condition.

text: Apple increased prices across multiple MacBook and iPad product lines and updated its online store accordingly. The pricing changes coincide with elevated memory and storage component costs and continued emphasis on higher-memory device configurations. Product sales and hardware lineup operations continue under the revised pricing structure.

meta.note: Pricing changes and product configuration strategy are reported together; the atomic event is the implemented price adjustment.

text: Micron shares advanced following the company's earnings release, with gains later moderating from session highs. Semiconductor equities also recorded broad recovery after earlier sector declines. Previously disclosed long-term customer agreements and forward revenue guidance remained active as market pricing adjusted.

meta.note: The atomic event is the market repricing following reported results, not the earnings release itself.
